text: The world feels fragmented and partially obscured, as if I am both present and distanced from the scene. The first image is full of lines and partial views, a fire extinguisher a reminder of human foresight, and I feel curious yet disoriented, as if I am missing some vital context. The second image is almost pure darkness, save for faint traces of light—this makes me reflect on the nature of perception and ignorance. Standing here, I feel keenly aware of how much of reality escapes me, and I am left with a sense of wonder and slight unease.
